title: Wonderful Waste!
description: NCERT Class 5 English (Marigold): 'Wonderful Waste!'. New words, comprehension, mixed tenses (past, present, future), and a writing task, closed by a chapter test.

nodes.title: New Words
nodes.skill: Read and use the new words from 'Wonderful Waste!': waste, leftover, useful, recycle.
nodes.teach_focus: What the new words from 'Wonderful Waste!' mean (waste, leftover, useful, recycle); use one correctly in a short phrase.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses two or more of the chapter's new words correctly.
nodes.bridge_focus: Name just one new word and what it means.

bridge_exercises.sentence: Food that is left after a meal is called ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Uses a new word in context.

bridge_exercises.sentence: To use waste again in a new way is to ___ it.
bridge_exercises.context: Checks the meaning of a key word.

exemplars: Yesterday we cooked, today we eat, and tomorrow we will share.
Nothing is wasted if we use it wisely.

nodes.title: Read and Understand
nodes.skill: Understand the chapter 'Wonderful Waste!' and answer a simple question about it.
nodes.teach_focus: The main idea and feeling of 'Wonderful Waste!'; answer a who/what/how question about it in one clear sentence.
nodes.success_criteria: Answers a simple question about the chapter in one clear sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Say in one sentence what the chapter is about.

bridge_exercises.sentence: In the story, the cook turns leftover vegetables into a ___ dish.
The clever cook turns leftover vegetables into a ___ dish.

exemplars: Yesterday we cooked, today we eat, and tomorrow we will share.
Nothing is wasted if we use it wisely.

nodes.title: Mixed Tenses (Past, Present, Future)
nodes.skill: Use mixed tenses (past, present, future) correctly.
nodes.teach_focus: Match the tense to the time: yesterday (past), every day (present), tomorrow (future, use 'will').
nodes.success_criteria: Uses mixed tenses (past, present, future) correctly in a sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Give one example of mixed tenses (past, present, future).

bridge_exercises.sentence: Which sentence is in the FUTURE tense?
Tomorrow I ___ help my mother in the kitchen.
bridge_exercises.context: Produces the grammar point in a sentence.

exemplars: Yesterday I cooked; today I eat; tomorrow I will share.
She will visit us next week.

nodes.title: Use It: Write a Sentence
nodes.skill: Write one sentence of your own using ideas from 'Wonderful Waste!'.
nodes.teach_focus: Write one clear sentence about 'Wonderful Waste!': who does what, with a capital letter and a full stop.
nodes.success_criteria: One complete sentence on the topic, with a capital and a full stop.

bridge_exercises.sentence: We can reduce waste by learning to ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Scaffolds writing with a frame to complete.

bridge_exercises.sentence: Tomorrow I ___ help my mother in the kitchen.
bridge_exercises.context: A second frame to produce the chapter's grammar.

exemplars: Yesterday we cooked, today we eat, and tomorrow we will share.
Nothing is wasted if we use it wisely.
